metadata.title: About RakshaAI: India's Free Scam Detection Platform
metadata.description: RakshaAI is India's free scam detection tool for websites, UPI IDs, and phone numbers. We verify businesses with GST and Aadhaar for a Raksha Trust Badge.

openGraph.title: About RakshaAI  Fraud Detection & Business Verification for India
openGraph.description: Free scam checker for India. Check websites, UPI IDs, phone numbers for fraud. Get your business verified with a Raksha Trust Badge. Built for India.

hero.title: Built for
hero.subtitle: Every day, thousands of Indians lose money to online scams. We're here to change that  one verified business and one protected user at a time, completely free.

mission.title: Why We Exist
mission.paragraph1: Online fraud is growing in India. Fake shopping sites, phishing WhatsApp messages, fraudulent payment links  crores of rupees are being stolen from hardworking Indians every single day. And legitimate businesses are losing customers because buyers can't tell who to trust.
mission.paragraph2Highlight: protection shouldn't cost money, and trust shouldn't be invisible.
mission.paragraph3: We built RakshaAI for students checking hostel booking sites, parents verifying online stores, senior citizens worried about bank SMS links  and for honest businesses that deserve to prove their legitimacy.

features.title: What Makes Us Different
features.subtitle: We're not here to make money from your fear. We're here to protect users and verify businesses  keeping India safer and more trustworthy.

items.title: Free Scam Detection for Everyone
items.description: Check any website, UPI ID, or phone number for fraud  free forever. Whether you're a student, parent, or senior citizen, safety is just one search away.

items.title: Business Trust Verification
items.description: Businesses can get GST and Aadhaar verified, earn a Raksha Trust Badge, and display their certificate to customers  for just ₹299/month.

items.title: Your Privacy Matters
items.description: We do not sell your data or associate scam check queries with your identity. Check queries are anonymised. We collect only the minimum data needed to operate the service.

items.title: AI-Assisted Detection
items.description: Our system checks public threat databases and community reports instantly. From fake shopping sites to phishing links  results in under 5 seconds.

items.title: Community Powered
items.description: When you report a scam, you help protect other Indians too. Every report strengthens our database and makes India safer.

items.title: No Tech Knowledge Needed
items.description: Simple, clear results. If a link is dangerous, we'll tell you exactly why in plain language anyone can understand.

items.title: Zero Cost, Forever
items.description: No "free trial" tricks. No premium plans. This service will be free forever for every single Indian. That's our commitment.

items.title: Your Privacy Matters
items.description: We do not sell your data. Scam check queries are anonymised and not associated with your identity. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

items.title: Transparent & Honest
items.description: If a website is risky, we'll tell you why. If our system is unsure, we'll say so. No hidden agendas. Just honest answers.

businessSection.title: For Businesses: Get Your Raksha Trust Badge
businessSection.subtitle: A verified RakshaAI badge tells every potential customer that your business has been GST-checked, Aadhaar-verified, and document-reviewed. Turn trust into revenue.

badges.name: Raksha Trusted
badges.description: Full verification: GST + Aadhaar KYC + Document review complete

team.mission: Our mission is to make India's digital economy safer  for consumers who need to verify before they trust, and for businesses that deserve to prove they're legitimate.

cta.title: Let's Build a Safer India Together
cta.subtitle: Protect yourself and your family from online fraud  free. And if you're a business, get verified today  your customers are checking.
